name: Should I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace my bathtub with a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a bathtub to a walk-in shower is ideal for daily convenience, modern aesthetics, and improved accessibility, but keeping at least one tub in the home is recommended for resale value. If your home has only one bathroom, removing the tub can make the property less appealing to future buyers with young children or pets. In homes with multiple bathrooms, converting a secondary tub or master tub into a low-threshold walk-in shower with frameless glass delivers a spacious, spa-like feel without sacrificing practicality. Shower pans require robust subfloor framing and waterproofing systems to prevent leaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: A walk-in shower improves accessibility and style, but keeping at least one tub in the home preserves resale appeal for families with young children.
